newsitem.title: UK: Euro jet fuel extends gains despite lengthy supply.
newsitem.headline: Euro jet fuel extends gains despite lengthy supply.

text.p: European jet fuel prices extended Friday's gains on Monday as benchmark crude and product futures continued to strengthen, traders said.
However, business was thin with barge and cargo premiums little changed despite stronger gasoline and gas oil futures. Traders said the market continued to look well supplied.

May IPE gas oil expired at noon on Monday $1 up at $171.75 a tonne with June backwardated by around $2.75 a tonne. But heavy buying and stronger U.S. products later pushed the June contract into contango.
Barge premiums were holding around June IPE +$19-21 fob ARA while cargoes were talked June IPE +$21-22 cif NWE.
Prices for Med material were showing a wide spread with 40,000 tonne cargoes from Greece talked as high as fob high quotes +$9 while French and Italian material was $2 below this.
